items.control_name: Enforce IMDSv2 (Instance Metadata Service v2) on EC2 Instances
items.description: EC2 instances must require IMDSv2 (HttpTokens=required) to mitigate SSRF attack vectors.
items.current_value: 18 of 20 EC2 instances require IMDSv2; 2 allow IMDSv1

items.control_name: Restrict EKS Control Plane Public Endpoint Access
items.description: EKS cluster API endpoints must be private or restricted to authorized enterprise CIDRs.
items.remediation_notes: Ensure worker node security groups allow HTTPS only from control plane ENIs.

items.control_name: Enforce IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA)
items.description: EKS workloads must use OIDC federated IRSA rather than node IAM role permissions.
items.current_value: OIDC provider configured; 100% of pods use IRSA annotations
items.recommended_value: All pods adopt IRSA; Node IAM roles stripped of application permissions
items.remediation_notes: Audit IAM trust policies on IRSA execution roles.

items.control_name: Enforce VPC Attachment for Sensitive Lambda Functions
items.description: Lambda functions accessing internal databases or Redis must execute within private VPC subnets.
items.current_value: All backend Lambda functions attached to private subnets with NAT Gateway
items.recommended_value: VpcConfig defined for internal-facing serverless functions
items.remediation_notes: Ensure Lambda execution roles do not contain wildcard resource permissions.
